_notes.source: Live https://www.toponefutures.com/ pricing panels read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 (Elite Daily, Elite Access, Instant Sim Funded, Ignite - every size), help-centre affiliate articles and Google Maps. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: standard = crossed-out price, promo = discounted price shown on the homepage cards (one-time fees). On 2026-10-20 one code, 30M, applied to the discounted plans: Elite Daily 50% off (was 60% with WC), Ignite 50% off, Instant Sim Funded 45% off (prices unchanged). Elite Access is 'BOGO' (buy one get one) at the flat $39 fee. A '$30 Million account giveaway' was also advertised.
_notes.elite_access_price: Elite Access is a flat $39 evaluation fee for every size (help centre). The homepage shows $139 / $189 / $259 / $359 crossed out next to $39, but those amounts match the activation fee due after passing (help centre: '$139 to $359, depending on account size'), not a full price, so standard = 39 and promo = null.
_notes.rules_detail: Elite Daily (V2): one-phase evaluation, 6% target, EOD trailing drawdown, daily loss limit in evaluation and funded, 40% consistency in the evaluation only, no activation fee, daily payouts, 50% daily progression rule; funded drawdown $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,500 (evaluation $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500 recorded); minimum 1 trading day on the funded account, none stated for the evaluation. Elite Access: $39 evaluation, 30 days to pass, no daily loss limit in the evaluation (funded DLL $500 / $1,000 / $1,250 / $1,750), evaluation drawdown $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,000 (funded $3,500 on 150K), minimum 1 trading day, 40% consistency on the funded account only, 5 profitable days per payout. Instant Sim Funded 2.0 (bought from 27 Jul 2026): no evaluation, no minimum trading days, EOD trailing drawdown, 20% consistency for payouts, profit target per payout 6% / 5% / 4%. Ignite: no evaluation, no minimum trading days, EOD trailing drawdown, 15% consistency, 5% profit target per payout, no overnight holding.
_notes.payout_caps: Max per payout in the sim-funded stage (help centre 'Maximum Payout Until Live'). Removed once moved to a live account.
_notes.fee_refund: Strict no-refund policy on all purchases (help centre), so false.
_notes.not_listed: Elite (classic 1-step evaluation), Elite Access Intraday, S2F Sim Pro, the Launchpad X-Ultra limited offer and the separate CFD product (Top One Trader) are not listed.
_notes.company: Top One Futures, LLC, 1621 Central Ave, Suite 8433, Cheyenne WY 82001 (homepage footer; a common registered-agent address). No official page states a founding year.
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Trustpilot 4.8 from 5,105 reviews (Trustpilot marks a paid subscription). None of the 19 newest reviews described a refused payout; almost all thanked named support staff. Passed.
_notes.marketing_stats_excluded: Payout totals, named trader payout amounts and the homepage 'earning potential' calculator are not reproduced.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Top One Futures page we could read.
_notes.affiliate_program: help.toponefutures.com affiliate articles (updated 2 Oct 2026; read 2026-10-20): first-time Elite / Instant Sim purchases 10% (Affiliate), 13% (Gold, $30K sales), 16% (Platinum, $100K), 20% (Diamond, $500K); recurring Instant Sim purchases 5% / 6% / 8% / 10%; $5 per reset and per activation fee; 2nd-tier 5% on first-time sales of affiliates you refer. Paid automatically on the 15th of each month to the method set in the dashboard, $100 minimum, 30-day verification per sale. Cookie length, country and comparison-site rules not read. Apply: https://www.toponefutures.com/affiliate-program
_notes.company_check: Google Maps search (2026-10-20) found no Top One Futures listing.

firm.name: Top One Futures
firm.about: Top One Futures is a US futures prop firm offering one-phase evaluations (Elite Daily and Elite Access) and instant-funded accounts with no evaluation (Instant Sim Funded and Ignite), from $25K to $150K. All accounts are one-time purchases, and every funded account uses a 90% profit split.

countries.notes: Citizens or residents of these countries can't use Top One Futures. Crimea is also listed separately, and you can't trade while travelling in a restricted country. Kosovo is coded XK (widely used, not an official ISO code).
